# D5b, raft-sql-poc's unsafeAckBeforeSync (mutAckBeforeSync): an append is
# acknowledged in AfterSync, which leaves only once its write is durable.
add-nodes 1 voters=1,2,3 term=1
----
ok

step 1 type=MsgApp from=2 term=1 ents=1,1
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=1
  Entries:
    1/1 command "e1-t1"
    2/1 command "e2-t1"
  AfterSync:
    1->2 MsgAppResp term=1 index=2
  Membership 1@0 2@0 3@0

deliver-msgs 2 drop
----
ok

storage-done 1
----
> 1 storage done seq=1 through 2/1

deliver-msgs 2 drop
----
  dropped 1->2 MsgAppResp term=1 index=2
